resources.string: Open photos from Google Camera in the gallery you like.
When Google Camera opens a photo in Google Photos, this service closes Google Photos and opens the photo in the gallery you chose. It does not read what is on your screen.
Tap the thumbnail in Google Camera and the photo opens in %1$s.
Tap the thumbnail in Google Camera and you will be asked which gallery to use.
Finish the steps below to make it work.
No gallery found — install one first
Limited — opens the gallery\'s home screen
Choose the gallery each time you open a photo from the camera
If the switch is greyed out, open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) and choose “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
Used only to find your latest photo and hand it to your gallery. Nothing leaves your phone.
Lets the app notice when the camera opens Google Photos, so it can open your gallery instead. It cannot read your screen.
Needed to find the photo you just took and open it in your gallery. Nothing is uploaded or shared. On the next screen, allow access to all photos for best results.
New gallery found: %1$s. You will be asked which one to use until you choose below.
